Concepts taught in class

Application of theory taught so far in the courses related to structures courses of all semester starting from first year. Gives you an hands on experience of how theory works with practical setup. 

Student Opinion

||With setup we have, it's good enough to practical experience of how the equations really works. How to Crack the Paper

{|class="wikitable"
